concept_architecture_boundary_rules: The set of executable architecture rules that assert module boundaries (enablement, provider discovery, theme inheritance) across the whole host codebase.
concept_conformance_spec: docs/CONFORMANCE.md, the specification document describing the host's conformance requirements and zero-diff gate for module packages.
concept_message_encryption_at_rest: A design note in the messaging developer docs about encrypting stored message content at rest.
concept_message_policy: MessagePolicy, the authorization policy class governing who can view or act on messages in the Private Messaging System.

concept_private_messaging_system: The Private Messaging System, a feature providing user-to-user messaging with real-time notifications and API access, documented in docs/MESSAGING.md.

portal_integration_independence: A design principle stating that real estate portal integrations are packaged and released independently of one another.

settings_module: Liberu Settings, the module providing the foundation.settings capability for site-wide configuration management.
